title: In-memory campaign state for a real-time bidder
name: Campaign state cache

questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how the cache decides which campaign state to keep? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
warm() has never completed successfully on this instance. What does Bidder.bid return?
choices: The highest bid among cached campaigns, since the map may contain event-applied entries
The first candidate campaign regardless of status

questions.prompt: Candidates A (active, 2,000,000 micros), B (paused, 5,000,000) and C (active, 900,000) are offered with a floor of 1,000,000. What is the result?
choices: null, because one candidate is paused

questions.prompt: The event stream is down for 20 minutes but warm() last succeeded 2 minutes ago. Which is true?
choices: The bidder stops bidding after 10 minutes of missing events
The bidder keeps bidding using whatever states it holds, since only the snapshot age is checked
Each lookup triggers loadAll to refresh the entry
isServable returns null for entries older than 10 minutes
